description: versions.env is the single pin file: ~55 KEY=value lines and nothing else in the repo pins anything. It is plain shell (sourced with `set -a`), so it has no package manifest for Renovate to read and none of Renovate's built-in managers can see it.

What makes it readable is the annotation directly above each pin: `# renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name>`, optionally followed by `extractVersion=` and `versioning=`, then a trailing `# ...` note. The customManager below turns exactly that pair of lines into a dependency.

THE ADJACENCY RULE: the annotation must be the line IMMEDIATELY above its pin, with nothing between them. The regex matches `annotation\nKEY=value` as one unit, and tools/bump-versions.sh parses the same way, so a comment inserted between the two silently removes the pin from BOTH. Put explanatory prose ABOVE the annotation, never below it.

Every pin that cannot have a datasource carries a `# no-datasource: <why>` line in the same adjacent position instead: apt signing-key digests, boolean feature gates, branch refs, a rustup channel, a filesystem path, the k8s MINOR STREAM. Those are considered-and-rejected, not missed.

PIN VALUES THAT ARE NOT VERSIONS: `apt` means the vendor apt repo decides and `latest` means resolved at install time. Both keep their annotation so the upstream is recorded for a reader, and the packageRule below disables updates for them so Renovate never rewrites the sentinel.

customManagers.description: Read versions.env: a `# renovate:` annotation plus the pin on the very next line.

packageRules.description: Sentinel pins. `apt` (the vendor repo decides) and `latest` (resolved at install time) are deliberate values, not versions; the annotation exists only so a reader can find the upstream.
Language runtimes: Go, Node, and the managers that install them.
Kubernetes CLI tooling installed by modules/35-kubernetes.sh.
Helm plugins (diff, unittest, schema, secrets) plus helm-docs, which is a standalone binary rather than a plugin but is owned by the same module.
IaC and security tooling. terraform and trivy are pinned `apt` and are disabled above; they stay listed so the group is complete.
The GO_TOOL_* family, installed with `go install MODULE@VERSION`.
Shell, editor and general CLI tooling.
AI agents and the Spec Kit ref, all opt-in profiles.

HELM_VERSION is `# pin-policy: manual`. helm/helm's current release is already v4.x and this is a bootstrap script, so Renovate must never propose the major. Raise this ceiling deliberately, together with modules/35-kubernetes.sh.
VIRTCTL_VERSION is `# pin-policy: manual`: it MUST match the cluster's KubeVirt version, which Renovate cannot know. Surfaced on the dependency dashboard, never auto-PR'd.

TREE_SITTER_VERSION is `# pin-policy: manual`: it must equal TREE_SITTER_VERSION in Ujstor/nvim-config's install.sh, which rebuilds the CLI with cargo whenever the one on PATH differs from its own pin. Bump both together. Surfaced on the dependency dashboard, never auto-PR'd.

yonahd/kor publishes the Helm CHART as kor-X.Y.Z in the same repository as the CLI's vX.Y.Z tags, and its releases/latest points at the chart. Restrict candidates to the CLI tag shape so a chart release can never be offered as a CLI bump.

kubernetes-sigs/kustomize is a monorepo whose real tags are kustomize/vX.Y.Z. The annotation's extractVersion strips the component prefix so Renovate writes back the bare vX.Y.Z that KUSTOMIZE_VERSION holds and modules/35-kubernetes.sh re-prefixes. Only kustomize/ tags may be offered.
